ESALA FESTIVAL OF MAHIYANGANA 2019

BY virtue or the powers vested in me by the Transfer of Powers (Divisional Secretaries)Act No.58 of 1992,and accordingto the regulations in terms of the provisions of the Pilgrimages Ordinance (chapter 362)publish in Government GazetteNo.9902 of 10th September 1948,Gazette No.10283 of 17th August 1951 Gazette No.14778 of 25lh March 1995 and GazetteNo.14752 of 09th June 1967, I, Dissanayaka Mudiyanselage Nimal Dissanayaka the Divisional Secretaries of Mahiyangana,do hereby inform the following orders shall be in force with regard to the camp of Mahiyangana Esala Festival 2019.
1.It is announced, the Mahiyangana Esala Festival will be commenced on the 30th August 2019 in the closure of theevent will be followed by the “Diya Kepeema” ceremony on the 14th September 2019.

2.The camp are for abode of pilgrims shall be the land demarcated by the 37th Mile post of Mahiyangana-Bibilamain road up to the 1/39 culvert in front of Mahiyangana National School,and the land situated between theMahiyangana-Meegahakiula road the leading to the clock tower in front of Mahiyangana hospital and new highway.
3.No person shall cook meals in “Vihara Maluwa’,'Dewala Boomiya”, “Palle Veediya” (The court yards of the Vihara,Bodiand Dewala or within those premises.

4.On a permit issues by me or by the officer incharge of the camp, Seelling of flowers, Joss sticks, candles,camphor, offering itemas and statues for fulfillment of vows,is allowed in the strip of land opposite the “Sthupa”at“Mada Veediya” and in the strip of Land issued to the left of the “Makara Thorana”.

5.Within the camp area specified in above section 2,selling and distribution of all food to pilgrims and selling of othercommodities and allowed in the 24 permanent building or the Officer in-charge of the camp. The area beyond 20ft,from the drainage system of both sides of Palle Veediya,Mada Veediya.Dutugamunu Vishrama Shala Mawatha

(Pilgrims road) Ammodilla road, Badulla Mahiyangana main road, Bodimaluwa Mawatha and the road in front ofthe “Sangawasa”(Bikku abode),prescribed as the way of perehara procession by the “Basnayaka Nilame”, is re-served for business purposes.
6.Near by Sangamiththaramara from the clock tower in Badulla main road to sids of the road and front of thepermanent shop it is trading activities by me.

7.Establishing tempory stalls/ mobile stalls and selling goods is entirely prohibited in the camp Including the areaof road sides along the Mahaweli river (comprised to temple land) except as permitted in statement 04 & 05mentioned .

8.Parking of private vehicles in the main street is hereby prohibited and no person shall enter any type of vehiclein to the camp area including bicycles and bullock carts without a permit issues by me or the officer in charge ofthe camp.

9.No person shall enter any moter vehicle in to the camp via the road reaching the sacred area by the side of the“Wahalkada” (Vestibule)witch faces Mahiyangana Bibila main road, Mahiyangana Bibila old road,the main accessto the camp area ,the road by the side of the clock tower located in front of the hospital, and the road by the side of1/39 culvert in front of Mahiyangana National School, unless written permission of obtained.
10.In view of security reasons, the lease of land on the Mahiyangana - Badulla road from Ridikoteleya Bridge toSangamitharamaya has been suspended during this year due to security reasons.
11.15.Establishing tempory stalls mobile stalls and selling good is entirely prohibited in the area of Infront of thehospital prenises.

12.A11 the temporary constructions in the leased out commercial lands shall comply with the specifications madeby the Department of Health.01 or 02 sanitary toilets adjacent to each boutique will have to be made available for theuse of pilgrims, if ordered, after the removel of the temporary buildings/sheds by the settlers of the leased out landat the end or the festival, old refuse and garbage including polythene shall be collected and disposed under thesupervision of the Public Health Instructors.

13.No person shall without the previous sanction of the Divisional Secretary, construct any booth or any sort ofbuilding or extend any building, so as to encroach on any land used or street for use as a street with in camp areaor on any land forming the banks of the river with in the camp area.
14.It is entirely prohibited providing seats for money to visit perahera.
15.No person shall construct any building within camp area unless a license has been obtained in that behalf fromme.
15th Regulation (Pilgrimages Ordinance)

(a)No person shall, without the previous of the Divisional Secretary, construct any booth or any sort of buildingany extend any building, so as to encroach any land used or set apart for use as a street with in the camp area orany land forming the bank of the river within the camp area.
(b)Firing of any sort of crackers is strictly prohibited with in the camp area.

(c)No person shall make any collection of money with in the camp area on selling tickets, flags, or on any otherpurpose unless permission is granted by the Divisional Secretary or other authorized officer.
DISSANAYAKA MUDIYANSELAGE NIMAL DISSANAYAKA,Divisional Secretary/Mahiyangana,Badulla District.

MAHIYANGANA ESALA FESTIVAL 2019

According to the regulations in terms of the provisions of the Pilgrimages Ordinance (chapter 362)publish in GovernmentGazette No.9902 of 10th September 1948,Gazette No 10283 of 17th August 1951 Gazette No.14778 of 25th March 1995 andGazette No.14752 of 09th June 1967 and the transfer of powers Act No.58 of 1992, I, Dissanayaka Mudiyanselage NimalDissanayaka the Divisional Secretaries of Mahiyangana,do hereby notify that the following places are allocated for thepurpose of distributing and selling of food items among the pilgrims.
(a)All the permanent and temporary building in between the 37th K.m 39/1 culvert opposite the NationalSchool, along Mahiyangana Bibila road.
(b)Permanent and temporary building on both side Mahiyangana/ Meegahakiula old road up the clock tower infront of the hospital.
(c)Temporary building construction on a permit issued by me, within the allocated ground for abode of pilgrimsin side the camp area.
No person shall distribute any sort of food item any place not appointed for the purpose, except specified in above .
DISSANAYAKA MUDIYANSELAGE NIMAL DISSANAYAKA,Divisional Secretary/Mahiyangana,Badulla District.
Divisional Secretary/ Mahiyangana,08th August 2019.
